outline: This course covers a wide range of fundamental technologies pertinent to Industry 4.0-Intelligent production, including a brief history of the industrial revolution, artificial intelligence algorithms, technologies and application examples of the Internet of Things, cloud service systems and information security technologies, big data management, analysis, and application examples, intelligent enterprise and factory management systems and applications, automation and robotics technology and applications, etc.
schedule:
Week 1 Introduction to Intelligent Production
Week 2 The Past and Present of Artificial Intelligence
Week 3 Principles of Contemporary Artificial Intelligence
Week 4 Intelligent enterprise and factory management system and application
Week 5 IoT basic technology and application
Week 6 Cloud Service System and Information Security Technology
Week 7 Mass data management, analysis, and application
Week 8 Value creation system
Week 9 Mid-term examination
Week 10 Special topic: Prognostic Maintenance
Week 11 Special topic: IoT in Industry 4.0
Week 12 Special topic: Industrial IoT
Week 13 Special topic: Cloud Manufacturing
Week 14 Special topic: Digital Twin in Manufacturing
Week 15 Special topic: Machine Learning and Data Mining in Manufacturing
Week 16 Special topic: Defect Detection
Week 17 Special topic: Cyber-Physical Systems
Week 18 Final exam
scorePolicy:
Report grade: 60%
Mid-term exam: 20%
Final exam: 20%

resources:
● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
